# Reverse Tax Calculator - Full Content & Documentation

> Comprehensive reference document for Reverse Tax Calculator (reversetaxcalculator.pro), containing all core mathematical formulas, regional tax multipliers, payroll net-to-gross calculations, and guide documentation for LLMs and AI agents.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Core Functionality

Reverse Tax Calculator (reversetaxcalculator.pro) is a suite of client-side web tools designed to solve tax calculations backwards. Unlike forward tax calculations (which multiply a pre-tax net subtotal by a tax rate percentage), reverse tax calculations isolate the original pre-tax net price (N) and the exact tax amount (T) from a known tax-inclusive gross total (G).

All calculations run in client-side JavaScript with 100% data privacy and zero server latency.

---

## 2. Core Mathematical Formulas

### 2.1 Universal Reverse Tax Formula
To extract pre-tax net price (N) from a tax-inclusive total (G) at tax rate (r):
- **Net Subtotal**: N = G ÷ (1 + r)
- **Tax Paid**: T = G - N

### 2.2 Tax Rate Percentage Solver
When net price (N) and gross total (G) are known, solve for effective tax rate percentage (r%):
- **Tax Rate %**: r% = [(G ÷ N) - 1] × 100

### 2.3 Multi-Tier / Dual Tax Rates (Additive)
For jurisdictions with multiple concurrent sales taxes (e.g., Quebec 5% GST + 9.975% QST = 14.975%):
- **Net Subtotal**: N = G ÷ [1 + r1 + r2]
- **Example**: N = G ÷ (1 + 0.05 + 0.09975) = G ÷ 1.14975

### 2.4 Reverse Tax and Tip
For restaurant dining receipts containing food subtotal (N), sales tax rate (r_tax), and gratuity tip rate (r_tip):
- **Food Subtotal**: N = Total Receipt ÷ (1 + r_tax + r_tip)

### 2.5 Net to Gross Salary (Payroll Withholding)
Payroll taxes are deducted from gross wages (unlike sales tax which is added to net price). To find required gross salary (G) for target take-home net pay (N) at effective withholding rate (t):
- **Required Gross Salary**: G = N ÷ (1 - t)

---

## 3. Global Division Multipliers Quick Reference

- **US California Sales Tax (7.25%)**: Multiplier = 1.0725 | Net = Gross ÷ 1.0725
- **US New York City Sales Tax (8.875%)**: Multiplier = 1.08875 | Net = Gross ÷ 1.08875
- **UK / EU Standard VAT (20.00%)**: Multiplier = 1.2000 | Net = Gross ÷ 1.2000
- **Canada Ontario HST (13.00%)**: Multiplier = 1.1300 | Net = Gross ÷ 1.1300
- **Canada Atlantic Provinces HST (15.00%)**: Multiplier = 1.1500 | Net = Gross ÷ 1.1500
- **Canada Quebec GST + QST (14.975%)**: Multiplier = 1.14975 | Net = Gross ÷ 1.14975
- **Australia GST (10.00%)**: Multiplier = 1.1000 | Net = Gross ÷ 1.1000
- **India Standard GST (18.00%)**: Multiplier = 1.1800 | Net = Gross ÷ 1.1800
